reader_summary.overview: Ric is the CEO and co-founder of Red Ventures, which has a portfolio of fast-growing digital businesses like Lonely Planet, The Points Guy, Bankrate. He began the business in 2000 and has grown it to now a global company with thousands of employees. Ric walks us through the early struggles that have led to what is now a flourishing investing platform.

key_points.text: Ric is the CEO and co-founder of Red Ventures, which has a portfolio of fast-growing digital businesses like Lonely Planet, The Points Guy, Bankrate.
Ric walks us through the early struggles that have led to what is now a flourishing investing platform.
We discuss the difference between living good and well, the power of forgiveness, and compounding more than just your capital.
